title: MusicDrop v1.5.2 Available
changelog:
• New Skin Theme Chooser: Gorgeous skin theme dialog with circular color swatches and wallpaper gallery for live one-tap theme switching
• Royal Plum & Deep Navy Themes: Added luxurious Royal Plum (Wine/Velvet) and Deep Navy color skins
• High-Contrast Light & Retro Themes: Completely overhauled Clean Light, iOS Light, and Retro themes with high-contrast text, clear search bar, and theme-adaptive artist cards
• Music Player Cover Art Fallback: When playing audio tracks without a video stream, the player displays a high-definition album cover with ambient blur backdrop instead of a black screen
• Quick Theme Shortcut: Instant skin theme palette button directly on the library and player headers
